name: ntfy
description: Send Kettu notices to ntfy. Sends the notices you pick to an ntfy topic on ntfy.sh, and lets you allow or deny a permission request from the notification.

description.en: Send Kettu notices to ntfy. Sends the notices you pick to an ntfy topic on ntfy.sh, and lets you allow or deny a permission request from the notification.
description.zh-CN: 把你选的 Kettu 通知发到 ntfy.sh 上的一个 topic，权限请求可以直接在通知上回答。

settings.title: Topic
settings.description: Leave it empty to use the random topic the plugin makes, which the ntfy view shows. Letters, numbers, - and _, up to 64. Anyone who knows the topic can read your notices and answer requests, so keep it long.

settings.title: Access token (optional)
settings.description: Only for a topic protected on ntfy.sh. It is sent to ntfy.sh and nowhere else.

description.en: Notices sent to your ntfy topic.
description.zh-CN: 发到你的 ntfy topic 的通知。

description.en: The topic to subscribe to, and a test notice.
description.zh-CN: 要订阅的 topic，以及测试通知。

title.en: Send a test notice to ntfy
title.zh-CN: 向 ntfy 发送测试通知
